email.subject: Quick note on the Northwind Co Plumbing site
email.body:
Hi Sofia,

I took a look at Northwind Co Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not set up for mobile, so most searches for a Harbor Falls plumber probably bounce before they can reach your number. And there's no reviews shown, which matters a lot when someone's picking between plumbers they don't know.

I also noticed heavy images slowing load time, no listed hours, and an outdated footer.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
